#Version1 launch checks —6November2026

##Launch mode
All existing quotation/consultation/Mobile/VIP and Standard Alterations/Care forms use the existing Web3Forms email route while _data/customer-request-backend.json.enabled=false. No database/dashboard storage is promised. Express Alterations/Care retain Terms/manual WhatsApp when private recording is off. Custom pictures remain manually attached by the customer in WhatsApp. No new paid service or subscription.

##Required before production approval
1. In the existing Web3Forms account,identify the form matching the existing publishable website key without sharing the key in reports. Confirm authorised recipient,verified state,domain restrictions allow mrsewingfashion.com and intended staging host,free-plan quota/rate limits/spam controls. No paid plan required by this code;actual account allowance unverified.
2. With an owner-authorised synthetic identity(not real customer data),submit the staging general quote,consultation,Standard Alterations and Standard Care;include a selected-design request to check name/link. Verify each arrives in the intended business inbox,not just browser/provider acknowledgement;check Spam/provider logs and reply-to. Repeat Mobile/VIP. If domain policy differs,repeat an authorised smoke test on production immediately after separately approved deployment. Record timestamps and pass/fail without publishing personal details. No real message was sent byCodex.
3. Confirm the production Pages project bound to mrsewingfashion.com,its current successful deploymentID/commit,certificate,HTTPS redirect,canonical host,build command python3 scripts/build_site.py/output.,and served indexing headers. Staging must carry noindex;production public pages must not. Current managed egress denies originHTTPS;Cloudflare account access unavailable. Public main checks do not expose a production deployment. MainSHA is not assumed to equal deployedSHA.
4. Before release,record rollback target(previous successful production deployment) and verify Pages rollback permission in that exact project. Keep current environment/binding configuration securely. After a problem,select that known-good production deployment through the authorised rollback procedure;do not reset/merge main as an emergency shortcut. Database backups/migrations require separate handling if activated;static rollback does not undo data or email.
5. After an approved launch,test real synthetic forms/receipt,validation/error recovery,Express Terms/WhatsApp,private endpoint logged-out denial,and correct releaseSHA/HTTP/index headers. No production sitemap submission without separate approval.

##Optional private service —NOT required for email-onlyV1
Keep frontend enabled=false and production PRODUCTION_PRIVATE_REQUESTS_ENABLED unset/false until verified. To activate later,require REQUESTS_ENABLED=true,PRODUCTION_PRIVATE_REQUESTS_ENABLED=true on apex,REQUESTS_DB,PRIVATE_REQUEST_FILES(private R2,no public domain),TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY/SECRET,REQUEST_EMAIL_ACCESS_KEY,REQUEST_RATE_SECRET(atleast32chars),STAFF_ACCESS_TEAM/AUD/ALLOWED_EMAILS;Access policy on staff/API;actual storage,unauthorised-denial/authorised-read,recipient and privacy/retention tests. Never LOCAL_TESTING inCloudflare. Do not copy secrets intoGit/chat. No binding,secret,provider setting,DNS or production deployment changed here.
